svg.title: Lambda Benchmark History: Geometric Mean versus Node.js
svg.desc: Line chart of benchmark-session geometric means relative to Node.js from Result through Result35, omitting partial Results5 through Result8 from the x-axis; session creation months are shown above the plot. The vertical axis is logarithmic from 0.1x to 100x. Values below 1x are faster than Node.js. Single-MIR sessions before Result16 are assigned to the Lambda typed series, and missing common-engine measurements are gaps.

svg.text: Geometric mean of engine time / Node.js time · lower than 1.0× is faster
Results5–8 were partial tests and are omitted from the x-axis.
Single-MIR sessions without a typed/untyped split are assigned to Lambda typed. Missing common-engine measurements are intentionally shown as gaps.
C2MIR starts at Result18: earlier C2MIR values were Lambda scripts through the transpiler; later values are native C benchmark ports.
Python points are available in Results3–4; Go is available in Result18. Vertical dividers mark the typed split and native-C2MIR transition.
